applicability: Small Node.js configuration module with exact JSON schema, scalar field validation, missing-file defaults, and atomic same-filesystem replacement.
limitations: Scalar integer, number, string, and Boolean fields only; no nested structures or migrations.
Atomic rename relies on the host filesystem; power-loss durability and concurrent-writer ordering require separate requirements.
Node.js runtime and local storage only.

parameter_schema.fields: Non-empty safe field map: type, default, optional numeric min/max, optional enum
